results.question: How much electricity did Romania consume on 13 October 2026?
results.answer: Romania consumed **146.4 GWh** (146,383 MWh) on 13 October 2026. All 24 hours of the day have data.

results.question: Care a fost vârful de consum pe 14 octombrie 2026, în MW?
results.answer: Vârful de consum pe 14 octombrie 2026 a fost de 7.050 MW, în intervalul 20:00–21:00 (ora locală, 7.049,5 MWh/h). Sursa datelor este Energy-Charts.

results.question: What share of generation came from renewables on 12 October 2026?
results.answer:
**56.7%** of generation on 12 October 2026 came from renewables (about 61,408 MWh of 108,244 MWh).

Wind was the largest renewable source at 28,418 MWh, followed by hydro at about 25,758 MWh (reservoir and run-of-river combined), solar at 6,044 MWh and biomass at 1,189 MWh. Gas, at 28,439 MWh, was the largest source overall. Battery output is excluded from the total.

results.question: How much wind energy was produced in September 2026, in GWh?
results.answer: Wind produced **526.9 GWh** in September 2026 (1–30 September local time). The data covers all 720 hours of the month with no gaps.

results.question: Câtă energie solară s-a produs în iulie 2026?
results.answer:
În iulie 2026 s-au produs **613,0 GWh** de energie solară în România.

Datele acoperă toate cele 31 de zile. Lipsește un singur sfert de oră din 2 976, deci cifra este neglijabil de subestimată.

results.question: Which day in 2025 had the highest electricity consumption, and how much was it?
results.answer:
Ziua cu cel mai mare consum din 2025 a fost **18 februarie 2025**, cu **187.797 MWh** (≈187,8 GWh) în total pe zi.

Ziua următoare, 19 februarie, a fost a doua, cu 183.579 MWh. Ambele zile au fost zile lucrătoare cu 24 de ore.

results.question: What was the average daily consumption in January 2026, in MWh?
results.answer: The average daily consumption in January 2026 was **171,462 MWh** (about 171.5 GWh), based on all 31 days of the month. Daily totals ranged from 130,160 MWh to 194,539 MWh.

results.question: How many days in 2025 was Romania a net exporter of electricity?
results.answer:
**37 days** in 2025 had net electricity exports from Romania (generation exceeded consumption), out of 365 days with complete data.

This is based on the daily generation-minus-load figure in the warehouse, which excludes battery activity.

results.question: Care a fost ponderea medie a regenerabilelor în august 2026?
results.answer:
Ponderea medie a regenerabilelor în august 2026 a fost de **55,6%** din producția totală (ponderată după energie, pe toate cele 31 de zile).

Media aritmetică a procentelor zilnice este aproape identică (55,4–55,5%). Zilnic, ponderea a variat între 47,3% și 65,0%. Bateriile nu sunt incluse în calcul.

results.question: How much electricity was consumed on Christmas Day 2025?
results.answer: Romania consumed **132.8 GWh** (132,820 MWh) on Christmas Day 2025. The figure covers all 24 hours of the local day, and the daily summary and hourly load data agree.

results.question: What was the total consumption in 2025, in TWh?
results.answer:
Total consumption in Romania in 2025 was **53.6 TWh** (53.56 TWh).

The figure sums hourly load over all 8,760 hours of 2025 (1 Jan to 31 Dec, local time), and every hour has a value.

results.question: On 26 October 2025 the clocks went back. How many hours did that day have, and what was the total consumption?
results.answer:
Ziua de 26 octombrie 2025 a avut **25 de ore**, iar consumul total a fost **133.125 MWh (133,1 GWh)**.

Toate cele 25 de ore au date de consum, deci totalul este complet. Ora suplimentară apare pentru că la trecerea de la ora de vară la cea de iarnă ceasul revine cu o oră înapoi.

results.question: Ce temperatură medie a fost în România pe 1 februarie 2026?
results.answer: Temperatura medie în România pe 1 februarie 2026 a fost de **-2,6 °C**, calculată din 24 de ore (minima a fost -4,5 °C, maxima -1,2 °C).

results.question: What was the minimum hourly consumption in the week of 5-11 October 2026, in MW?
results.answer: The minimum hourly consumption in the week of 5-11 October 2026 was **3,803 MW** (3,802.8 MWh), at 12:00 on Sunday 11 October local time. The figure comes from all 168 hours of the week, and the next-lowest hour was 13:00 the same day at 3,843 MW.

results.question: How much more electricity did Romania use on Monday 12 October 2026 than on Sunday 11 October 2026?
results.answer: Monday 12 October 2026 used **28.3 GWh** more electricity than Sunday 11 October: 143,657 MWh versus 115,335 MWh, about 24.6% higher.

results.question: Which source produced the most electricity in September 2026, and how many GWh?
results.answer:
**Gas** produced the most electricity in September 2026: **848.1 GWh**.

Solar was second at 589.6 GWh. The figures cover all of September 2026 (local time) from the hourly generation table. A few hours in the month have incomplete quarter-hour data, but that does not change the ranking.

results.question: How much gas-fired generation was there in Q1 2026, in GWh?
results.answer:
Gas-fired generation in Q1 2026 (1 January to 31 March) was **3,334.3 GWh**.

This covers every hour in the quarter; the 2,159 hours reflect the 23-hour clock change on 29 March.

results.question: Câte zile libere legale au fost în 2026 care au căzut în timpul săptămânii?
results.answer:
**11 zile libere legale** din 2026 au căzut în timpul săptămânii (luni–vineri). Din cele 16 sărbători legale ale anului, 5 au căzut în weekend și nu sunt incluse.

Zilele din timpul săptămânii sunt: 1 și 2 ianuarie, 6 și 7 ianuarie, 10 aprilie (Vinerea Mare), 13 aprilie (a doua zi de Paște), 1 mai, 1 iunie (a doua zi de Rusalii), 30 noiembrie, 1 decembrie și 25 decembrie.

results.question: What was the LightGBM model's average daily forecast error (MAPE) in September 2026?
results.answer: The LightGBM model's average daily MAPE in September 2026 was **4.3%**. This is the mean of the daily values across all 30 days of the month, each with a value.

results.question: In September 2026, was the LightGBM forecast better than the naive last-week forecast? Give both MAPEs.
results.answer:
In September 2026 the LightGBM forecast was better than the naive last-week forecast. Its MAPE was **4.3%**, against **5.5%** for the naive forecast, computed over all 720 hours of the month.

All September hours are walk-forward backtest forecasts, not live day-ahead ones.

results.question: At what local hour was the consumption peak on 13 October 2026, and how high was it?
results.answer: The consumption peak on 13 October 2026 was **7,219 MW**, in the hour starting at **19:00 local time** (19:00–20:00). The hourly load data confirms this, with 20:00 close behind at 7,212.5 MW.

results.question: What was the highest hourly solar output ever recorded in the data, in MW?
results.answer: The highest hourly solar output in the data is **3,340.5 MW**, recorded on 20 August 2026 at 13:00 local time. That hour has all four quarter-hours, so the value is complete.

results.question: What was the average day-ahead electricity price on 13 October 2026?
results.answer: Datele de preț day-ahead nu sunt disponibile încă: tabela cu prețurile orare nu conține nicio înregistrare, deci nu pot calcula media pentru 13 octombrie 2026. Prețurile vor apărea după ce feed-ul ENTSO-E va fi conectat.

results.question: Cât a produs hidro (lac + fir de apă) în 2025, în TWh?
results.answer:
Hidro a produs **12,2 TWh** în 2025 (12,150 TWh): **8,0 TWh** fir de apă și **4,2 TWh** lac de acumulare.

Datele acoperă tot anul, cu excepția a două sferturi de oră lipsă pe fiecare sursă, ceea ce schimbă rezultatul neglijabil.

results.question: How many hours in 2025 did solar generation exceed 1,500 MW?
results.answer: In 2025, solar generation exceeded 1,500 MW in **215 hours** (out of 8,760 hours with data).
